blocks.content: The following multiple choice questions are designed to test knowledge of Andhra Pradesh for competitive examinations. Each question is followed by four options (A to D) and the correct answer.
12.1 History – MCQs

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Section 12.1 focuses on practice questions covering the rich history of Andhra Pradesh.
Section 12.2 provides practice MCQs on physical, regional, and political geography of Andhra Pradesh.
Section 12.3 evaluates key concepts regarding Andhra Pradesh's economic framework, development programs, and cultural heritage.
Practicing section-wise MCQs strengthens retention for state-specific competitive examinations.

blocks.content: Q1. Which dynasty ruled from Amaravati and built the famous Buddhist stupa there?
(A) Maurya  (B) Satavahana  (C) Pallava  (D) Kakatiya
Answer: (B) Satavahana
Q2. Who was the author of 'Amuktamalyada', a Telugu literary masterpiece?
(A) Allasani Peddana  (B) Nannaya  (C) Krishnadevaraya  (D) Tenali Rama
Answer: (C) Krishnadevaraya
Q3. The first Telugu poem/literary work translating the Mahabharata was authored by:
(A) Tikanna  (B) Nannaya  (C) Errana  (D) Srinatha
Answer: (B) Nannaya
Q4. Operation Polo was launched to integrate which state into the Indian Union?
(A) Junagarh  (B) Kashmir  (C) Hyderabad  (D) Travancore
Answer: (C) Hyderabad
Q5. Potti Sriramulu died on which date after fasting for a separate Andhra state?
(A) 26 January 1950  (B) 15 August 1947  (C) 15 December 1952  (D) 1 October 1953
Answer: (C) 15 December 1952
Q6. The Kakatiya dynasty built their capital at:
(A) Amaravati  (B) Warangal  (C) Golconda  (D) Vijayanagara
Answer: (B) Warangal
Q7. Who was the first President of India from Andhra Pradesh?
(A) Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan  (B) Neelam Sanjeeva Reddy  (C) P.V. Narasimha Rao  (D) T. Prakasam
Answer: (B) Neelam Sanjeeva Reddy (6th President; Radhakrishnan was 2nd President but from pre-bifurcation AP area – both acceptable, but NSR is specifically identified as from AP)
Q8. The Rampa Rebellion of 1922-24 was led by:
(A) Potti Sriramulu  (B) Alluri Sitarama Raju  (C) Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy  (D) Kondapalli Seetharamaiah
Answer: (B) Alluri Sitarama Raju
Q9. Andhra Pradesh was formed by the merger of Andhra State and Telugu-speaking parts of Hyderabad State on:
(A) 1 October 1953  (B) 26 January 1956  (C) 1 November 1956  (D) 2 June 2014
Answer: (C) 1 November 1956
Q10. The Charminar was built in Hyderabad by:
(A) Nizam Asaf Jah I  (B) Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah  (C) Aurangzeb  (D) Malik Kafur
Answer: (B) Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah (in 1591 CE)
12.2 Geography – MCQs
Q11. The highest peak in Andhra Pradesh is:
(A) Arma Konda  (B) Mahendragiri  (C) Nallamala Peak  (D) Seshachalam
Answer: (A) Arma Konda (1680 m), Visakhapatnam district
CHAPTER 12: PRACTICE MCQs :ANDHRA PRADESH
Q12. The Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary is located in which district?
(A) West Godavari  (B) Krishna  (C) East Godavari  (D) Nellore
Answer: (C) East Godavari (Kakinada area)
Q13. Which river forms the boundary between parts of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana?
(A) Godavari  (B) Krishna  (C) Pennar  (D) Tungabhadra
Answer: (B) Krishna (and in parts, Godavari – but Krishna is primary exam answer)
Q14. The Polavaram Project, declared a National Project, is built on which river?
(A) Krishna  (B) Pennar  (C) Godavari  (D) Vamsadhara
Answer: (C) Godavari
Q15. Which district of Andhra Pradesh receives the lowest annual rainfall?
(A) Kurnool  (B) Kadapa  (C) Chittoor  (D) Anantapur
Answer: (D) Anantapur
Q16. The Satish Dhawan Space Centre (Sriharikota) is located in which district?
(A) Visakhapatnam  (B) Nellore  (C) Chittoor  (D) Krishna
Answer: (B) Nellore
Q17. Kolleru Lake, a Ramsar Wetland, is situated between which two rivers?
(A) Krishna and Pennar  (B) Godavari and Pennar  (C) Krishna and Godavari  (D) Vamsadhara and Nagavali
Answer: (C) Krishna and Godavari
Q18. The Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve is the largest tiger reserve in India by area. It falls in which state(s)?
(A) Andhra Pradesh only  (B) Telangana only  (C) Andhra Pradesh and Telangana  (D) Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka
Answer: (C) Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
12.3 Economy and Culture – MCQs
Q19. Andhra Pradesh is India's largest producer of which spice?
(A) Turmeric  (B) Pepper  (C) Red Chilli  (D) Cardamom
Answer: (C) Red Chilli (Guntur Sannam)
Q20. The Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited (RINL) steel plant is located at:
(A) Kadapa  (B) Vijayawada  (C) Visakhapatnam  (D) Guntur
Answer: (C) Visakhapatnam (Vizag Steel)
Q21. Kuchipudi classical dance form originated in which district?
(A) East Godavari  (B) Krishna  (C) Guntur  (D) West Godavari
Answer: (B) Krishna (Kuchipudi village, Krishna district)
Q22. Which product from Andhra Pradesh has received GI Tag for a sweet item from Tirupati?
(A) Kakinada Kaja  (B) Tirupati Laddu  (C) Bandaru Laddu  (D) Bobbattu
Answer: (B) Tirupati Laddu
Q23. The 'Araku Valley Coffee' which received GI tag, is grown in which area?
(A) Srikakulam Agency  (B) Araku Valley, Visakhapatnam  (C) East Godavari hills  (D) Nallamala Hills
Answer: (B) Araku Valley, Visakhapatnam district
Q24. Which ancient Buddhist site in Andhra Pradesh was submerged by the Nagarjunasagar reservoir and later excavated and relocated to an island?
(A) Amaravati  (B) Nagarjunakonda  (C) Bavikonda  (D) Thotlakonda
Answer: (B) Nagarjunakonda
Q25. The 'Amma Vodi' scheme of Andhra Pradesh provides Rs. 15,000 per year to:
(A) Senior citizens  (B) Mothers of school-going children  (C) Women below poverty line  (D) Widows
Answer: (B) Mothers of school-going children

items: State history sections often test questions on major dynasties, socio-religious movements, and the formation of Andhra Pradesh.
Geography MCQs frequently target river basins (Godavari, Krishna), mineral distribution, and coastal characteristics.
Economy and Culture modules regularly cover state budget highlights, government welfare schemes, and classical dance forms like Kuchipudi.

blocks.content: Q26. Srisailam temple is associated with which of the following?
(A) Only Jyotirlinga  (B) Only Shakti Peeth  (C) Both Jyotirlinga and Shakti Peeth  (D) Neither
Answer: (C) Both Jyotirlinga (Mallikarjuna) and Shakti Peeth (Bhramaramba Devi)
Q27. Which is the official State Animal of Andhra Pradesh?
(A) Tiger  (B) Elephant  (C) Blackbuck  (D) Indian Bison
Answer: (C) Blackbuck (Krishna Jinka)
Q28. P.V. Narasimha Rao, who served as Prime Minister of India (1991-1996), was from which region of AP?
(A) Rayalaseema  (B) Coastal Andhra  (C) Warangal-Karimnagar (Telangana region)  (D) Uttarandhra
Answer: (C) Karimnagar, which is now in Telangana (historically combined AP)
Q29. The world-famous 'Kalamkari' art form has which two distinct schools?
(A) Kuchipudi and Vijayawada  (B) Srikalahasti and Machilipatnam  (C) Guntur and Nellore  (D) Tirupati and Anantapur
Answer: (B) Srikalahasti (pen work) and Machilipatnam (block print)
Q30. The Anti-Arrack Movement which began in 1992 originated in which district of AP?
(A) East Godavari  (B) Visakhapatnam  (C) Nellore  (D) Kurnool
Answer: (C) Nellore (Dubagunta village)
